title: A/R Collection: the Location column shows with two or more locations
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop has open customer documents at three locations, and you untick them one by one on A/R Collection.
  • You are an Admin user (the "Admin" role) working at {Location-A}, your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open A/R documents at three locations, {Location-A}, {Location-B} and {Location-C}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Starting screen: A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look for the Location column.
  2. Untick {Location-C} in the Location menu.
  3. Untick {Location-B} as well.
  4. Click "Clear selection".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: shown (All locations, three in the list).
  • Step 2: shown (two ticked).
  • Step 3: hidden (one ticked).
  • Step 4: hidden (none ticked; the empty state shows).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location), story SV-11536 (Story 6, Location column)

  • S6-R2: “The column is shown when two or more locations are ticked (All locations counts when the report's list has two or more) and hidden when one or none is ticked.”
  • S6-N1: “With one location chosen, the column is hidden on screen and in the export.”
  • S5-R6a: “With no location ticked ("Clear selection" or unticking every row), the report shows no rows: the native empty state (S8-R5) with "Clear all filters", no totals and no Location column. An export from that state downloads nothing and shows "Empty export", "Export didn't yield any results", as on Sales By Customer.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p4-opens-on-all-locations.png: figure "Opens on All locations" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column"
  • ar-ap-p4-one-location-ticked.png: figure "One location ticked" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column"
  • ar-ap-p4-cleared-no-locations.png: figure "Cleared: No locations" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column"

The design's own words:

  • "Native filter row: As of, Customer, Past due, then Location, which opens on "Location: All locations". Untouched, the report matches today. Column labelled "Location", after Date. S5-R1, S5-R2, S5-R5, S6-R1 to S6-R3." (caption of "Opens on All locations")
  • "One location ticked ("1 selected"): the chip names it, rows, totals and exports narrow to it, and the Location column hides. S5-R6, S5-R7, S5-R10, S6-N1." (caption of "One location ticked")
  • ""Clear selection" leaves no location chosen: the chip reads "Location: No locations" and stays visible, and the table shows the native empty state "No record matches these filters" with "Clear all filters". S5-R6a, S5-R9." (caption of "Cleared: No locations")

Difference from the PRD (DD-03), closed: PRD version 5 said with no location ticked, "the native empty state (S8-R5) with "Clear all filters", no totals and no Location column" (S5-R6a); the design shows "Location: No locations" with a Totals row reading $0.00 and $0.00 under the headings, above the empty state. Chris Ward ruled on 23 Oct 2026 (answer 13): no Totals row, as the PRD says; the design picture will be corrected. This case follows the PRD (S5-R6a, unchanged in version 9). The held design-version case D-78 (C715560) was deleted from TestRail on 26 Oct 2026 with the QA lead's go-ahead (snapshot in v9-pass-2026-10-26/deleted/).
